title: Ordering Distillation, Quantization, and Pruning
analysis: Dense-calibrated quantization used scale 0.107549; recalibration after pruning used 0.107549. Held-out RMSE was 10.841832 for quantize-then-prune and 10.841832 for prune-then-quantize. A 35-step constrained teacher recovery reached 11.202020 at 60.0% sparsity.
conclusion: Compression order is part of the model recipe because pruning, calibration, and recovery state do not commute.
